narrative.overview:
Raised navy racks of tactile buttons on a deep Audius night, where only the things that are on, playing or selected light up. STUDIO is an unofficial, community-built browser DAW made by and for the Audius community; it is not an Audius product and the interface never says or implies otherwise. The Audius lockup in the top bar is the only brand mark, white and single-colour on dark themes.

The mode is Operate: long, hands-on sessions of dragging clips, tapping pads and riding faders. The interface keeps chrome compact, every control stays standard and obvious, and the work area gets the space. The look keeps the Audius dark-purple brand and Avenir Next, and adds pro-studio craft: a real type scale, layered panel depth, precise wells and knobs, lit states, and short purposeful motion. The button language comes from the owner's liked mock-up (`docs/design-reference/31-owner-liked-top-buttons.jpg`): separate raised rounded buttons a step lighter than their panel, a hairline light border, a faint top highlight and a soft shadow; bold icon plus label; a dark inset track for segmented controls with a magenta-to-violet active segment; a larger lit violet Play; inset LCD wells with bright blue tabular numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Four-surface depth: wells, panes, bars and racks, raised controls, with popovers between.
The owner's button language, shared by every control through one set of tokens.
Lit states only: nothing glows at rest; on, playing and selected things light up.
Tabular Audius-blue read-outs in inset wells; no monospace face anywhere.
One family (Avenir Next) with a 15px floor for all text.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each colour has one job. Accent means brand, create and value fill. Lit blue means selected or on. Info blue means time. State colours mean channel state. Red means delete and record only.

rules.name: The Theme Contract Rule
rules.body: Every theme block maps the full role set. There is no hex outside the token section of `styles.css`. Canvases read `--cv-*`, never literals. The custom accent picker rewrites the same role tokens (`--accent-fill`, `--accent-gradient`, `--play-gradient`, `--accent-rgb`), so a picked accent re-themes everything.

rules.name: The No Newer Colour Syntax Rule
rules.body: The owner's Galaxy Note 3 (about Chrome 95) and older iPads (Safari 14 to 15) must work. Opaque blends are precomputed per theme as hex; alpha tints use comma-separated rgb triplets (`rgba(var(--lit-rgb), 0.6)`). No colour-mixing function, no oklch, no `@layer`, no `:has()`.

rules.name: The 15px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text is smaller than 15px. `kbd` hint chips are the single exemption, and they are hidden on touch screens. Never set a font size on a component class; use the type tokens (`--fs-label`, `--fs-title`, `--fs-section`, `--fs-readout-*`).

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: Numbers in wells are Avenir with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums`. No monospace face is loaded or named.

rules.name: The Case Rule
rules.body: Window titles are Title Case. Section titles are written in Title Case and uppercased by CSS at 0.08em; source strings are never typed in capitals. The separator is " · ". Weights used anywhere: 400, 500, 600, 700.

rules.name: The Four Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Wells are surface-0; panes are surface-1; bars, title bars and racks are surface-2; controls are surface-3; popovers sit between with shadow-3.

rules.name: The Well Rule
rules.body: Wells are recesses with no border and no box-shadow; the recess is a shade painted as a background layer (`--well-shade`). Never nest a raised card inside a rack or a card inside a card.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow only on Play, lit toggles, active segments, pad hits and LEDs. Every glow has a y-offset and a negative spread; there are no zero-offset coloured halos. Nothing glows at rest. A selected row is an edge (1px lit ring), not a glow.

rules.name: The Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: An Audius wallpaper paints behind the arrangement only, under a theme-aware veil (88% surface-0). Panes stay solid: no glass and no backdrop blur.

rules.name: The Radius Ladder Rule
rules.body: 4px for chips, kbd and meters (`--r-xs`); 6px for small controls (`--r-sm`); 8px for controls (`--r-md`, `--r-ctl`); 12px for racks, popovers and touch controls (`--r-lg`; 10px for small touch controls, `--r-ctl-sm`); 16px for dialogs (`--r-xl`); a full pill (`--r-pill`) for range tracks, switches and scrollbar thumbs. Borders are 1px hairlines. There are no coloured side borders thicker than 1px: selected list items use an inset ring, never a side tab.

rules.name: The Pads Are Pads Rule
rules.body: Never waveforms, never headphone, S or M chips, never clip-style content on a pad. The owner said so explicitly; the mock-ups are wrong on this point.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: One primary button per surface. Creating things is Accent; committing is Primary.

rules.name: The Quiet Delete Rule
rules.body: Delete is a trash icon, quiet at rest, red only on hover or focus. Close is a neutral ghost cross.

rules.name: The Pressed-Not-Shrunk Rule
rules.body: Pressing moves a control one pixel down with an inset shadow. It never scales.

dos: Do use `setLit()` and `aria-pressed` for every on/off control.
Do read colour, radius, shadow, size and motion from the tokens; add a role to every theme block before using it.
Do keep one primary action per surface and show delete as a quiet trash icon.

Do keep text at 15px or more and touch targets at 44px or more; run the harness probe at all seven viewports (1920×1080, 1440×900, 1366×768, 1024×1366 touch, 1366×1024 touch, 360×640 touch, 640×360 touch).
Do give older browsers a complete fallback on the line before anything newer than Chrome 95 or Safari 14.
Do keep geometry in the legacy layout rules and skin in the system block.
donts: Don't copy the mock-up's gradient Audius glyph on dark themes; the lockup is white and single-colour.
Don't draw waveforms or chips on pads.
Don't use zero-offset coloured halos or a glow at rest.
Don't add `!important` for skin, or `@layer`, a colour-mixing function, oklch or `:has()`.
Don't hard-code colours in components or canvases.
Don't add a second accent for "on"; lit blue is the one "on".
Don't put a raised card inside a rack or a card inside a card; wells are recesses.
Don't call the app official or use other music software's names, logos or skins.
